_comment: The SHAPE v2 — the full take plays FIRST (the original comedy arc, unbroken, beat rolling calmly underneath), then the remix answers as the flip. JESUS CHRIST IN RICHMOND PARK. The joke is structural: the lofi beat never once panics. Long dusty peace, the first dignified call, escalation while the kit keeps smoking, JESUS CHRIST alone in a stopped world, then the STAMPEDE DROP turns the famous run into percussion. The double rides it, the full run plays over everything like a choir, and the park closes its eyes on a distant underwater fenton.
